source.purpose: To provide a statewide, standardized repository for structure and address point data. The Structures/Addresses Framework complies with the NENA Standard for NG9-1-1 GIS Data Model and is designed to support a wide range of public and private sector uses including: 9-1-1 and emergency response, elections management, broadband internet mapping, census programs, planning, natural resource studies, etc.
